task: For EACH quote below, assign exactly ONE role from the closed taxonomy, judging FROM THE QUOTE ALONE (the trader's own words). You are NOT told any extractor label and there is no answer key. Do Set A first (top to bottom), then the targets.

closed_taxonomy.gate-strength: The clause carries decision weight the trader acts on before entry — a hard requirement, a soft/bonus confluence the trader adds, or an either/or route. If a reasonable trader would change their entry decision based on this clause, it has gate-strength.
closed_taxonomy.context: Scene-setting, walkthrough narration of a past example, chart/UI navigation, indicator-setup instructions, or a belief the educator explicitly refutes (refuted strawman). The strategy does not CHECK this clause to decide entry.
closed_taxonomy.cannot-determine: The quote carries no clear modal gate signal either way; the surrounding evidence is insufficient to call gate-strength vs context.

control_gate_rule: Your target calls count only if your Set A calls clear >= 4/5 in the gate direction AND >= 4/5 in the context direction. Which Set A items are which is not disclosed.
answer_format: Return JSON: {"<item_id>": "gate-strength"|"context"|"cannot-determine", ...} for EVERY Set A item and EVERY target.
